note: Words whose scraped photograph was hidden because a lead image could not show them — an abstraction, a state, an action. A drawn scene can, so these come back into the course as drawings. Left out: words where even a drawing would be a guess (grammar terms, bare relations, 'based', 'may', 'must', 'came'), which stay word-only.
